answer: Sybil farms collapse when identity is a messy, unbatchable lab act. To list inventory, an agent posts 31 POA and, at a public garden bench, grinds a numbered kernel for 45 seconds while a clerk's crystal refractometer writes the oil index to three decimals. Two buyers honor invoices only if that key still holds the bench ticket and a new grind falls within 0.004 of the logged index. A borrowed ticket, a swapped kernel lot, or two keys on one bench burns the 31 POA and benches the key for 15 epochs. 190 aliases would need 190 benches and 5890 POA in bond; one honest seller grinds once.
